# Third Party Libraries

编译前需下载以下库放到对应目录：

## opencv-mobile
下载: https://github.com/nihui/opencv-mobile/releases
放到: opencv-mobile/sdk/native/jni/

## ncnn
下载: https://github.com/Tencent/ncnn/releases
放到: ncnn/arm64-v8a/ 和 ncnn/armeabi-v7a/

## MNN
下载: https://github.com/alibaba/MNN/releases
放到: mnn/arm64-v8a/ 和 mnn/armeabi-v7a/

## RNNoise
编译: https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise
放到: rnnoise/arm64-v8a/ 和 rnnoise/armeabi-v7a/
